highlights.headline: Why US train travel lags behind Asia and Europe
highlights.summary: As flights get pricier and gas prices stay high, more US travelers are turning to trains — and hitting a system built for freight, not people.

items.title: Super Typhoon Bavi makes landfall on US Pacific islands with huge wind gusts
items.description: The storm, with winds of nearly 290km/h (180mph) and gusts of 350km/h, is lashing the island of Rota.

items.title: World Cup: Trump thanks FIFA for suspending Balogun's red card ban
items.description: US President Donald Trump reportedly called Gianni Infantino to ask him to lift Falorin Balogun's red card ban to allow him to play against Belgium. The Belgian FA has called the decision "astonishing."

items.title: Cargo ship reportedly attacked in Red Sea off Yemen
items.description: The UK Maritime Trade Office said a vessel was attacked 30 nautical miles southwest of Hodeida, which is under control of the Houthi rebels. The Iran-backed group recently vowed to resume attacks in the Red Sea.

items.title: Wildfires rage in Portugal, Greece, France and Spain
items.description: Six countries in southern Europe have been hit by wildfires. One of the blazes, in southwestern France, could affect Monday's third stage of the Tour de France, authorities warn.

items.title: UK Reform's Nigel Farage faces fresh misconduct allegations
items.description: Populist right leader Nigel Farage has been referred to the UK parliament's standards watchdog after a report that he failed to declare benefits. The Reform UK leader is already under investigation over a separate gift.

items.title: Iran's supreme leader absent as senior officials attend ayatollah's funeral
items.description: Mojtaba Khamenei has not been seen in public since the attack which killed his father at the outset of the US-Israel war with Iran.

items.title: Watch: Lyse Doucet on emotion and politics at Tehran funeral of former supreme leader
items.description: The BBC's chief international correspondent reports from Tehran where funeral events are taking place in honour of Iran's former leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.
